title: Junior Backend Developer
description: We are looking for a Junior Backend Developer to design, build, and maintain robust server-side applications and RESTful APIs. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable backend services, optimize database queries, and integrate cloud services.
education_requirement: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related technical field
responsibilities: Develop high-performance REST APIs and backend microservices.
Design and manage PostgreSQL and MongoDB database schemas.
Deploy and maintain containerized applications using Docker and AWS.
Collaborate with frontend engineers to integrate user-facing elements.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Seeking a talented Frontend Developer passionate about building fast, accessible, and delightful web applications. You will work with React, TypeScript, and modern state management to build responsive client-side interfaces.
education_requirement: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
responsibilities: Translate Figma designs and wireframes into clean, reusable React components.
Optimize web applications for maximum speed, responsiveness, and cross-browser fidelity.
Integrate frontend state with RESTful APIs and WebSocket endpoints.
Maintain unit and component tests with Jest and React Testing Library.

title: Data Analyst
description: We are seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to uncover actionable insights from large datasets, build executive dashboards, and drive business decision-making through statistical modeling and automated data pipelines.
education_requirement: Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, or Data Science
responsibilities: Write complex SQL queries and Python ETL scripts to extract and transform large business datasets.
Build interactive Tableau and PowerBI dashboards for stakeholder reporting.
Perform statistical analysis and exploratory data modeling to detect trends.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to cross-functional leadership.
